# Raw pre-outcome baseline

`cast-outcomes-baseline.json` is an actual unedited capture from source59612db97a902eacce48ea183806bd09f2826715 with published HF3.0.0, Node26.12.0, pnpm12.14.0. It contains `saveGame(createGame(416))`, the exact three public inputs, and the raw result of applying those inputs to `loadGame(initial)`. Captured before outcome implementation on2026-10-26. No edited world state, Person, RNG, history or normalization. It is a regression baseline, not a player run or acceptance evidence.
